Subject: Intro & request: evaluation plan + billing path for GCP private offer

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — Novara’s ML team was impressed with the latency numbers. Procurement and finance asked me to put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we can map evaluation milestones to the procurement triggers and invoice path for a GCP private offer. Primary asks from my side:

- A clear set of evaluation checkpoints (what constitutes "eval complete")
- Which milestone triggers finance to issue a PO vs. turning on Marketplace billing
- Expected timing for private offer creation and invoice cadence
- Required compliance docs (SOC2, data processing addendum) to attach to the PO

I attached a brief RFP extract that outlines Novara’s procurement constraints. Can we get a draft MAP and a suggested 6-week timeline? Suggest copying in legal/finance if useful.

Appreciate it —
Alex

Subject: Re: Intro & request: evaluation plan + billing path for GCP private offer

Alex —

Thanks for the RFP excerpt. I drafted an initial MAP that sequences eval milestones to procurement gates and the billing transition. See attached (MAP-v1.xlsx). High-level view:

1) Week 0-2: Pilot enablement (PO optional)
   - Redwood provides a short-term hosted trial; Novara runs 3 production-like flows.
   - Deliverables: latency/cost report, end-to-end test cases

2) Week 3-4: Private offer setup & legal redline
   - Once pilot metrics meet thresholds, Novara issues a PO or signs a short MSA addendum.
   - Redwood generates GCP private offer (billing via Marketplace); we can alternatively invoice monthly if needed.

3) Week 5-6: Cutover & invoice trigger
   - Private offer activated and billed through GCP Marketplace. Invoice trigger depends on whether Novara prefers marketplace billing (charges via GCP) or Redwood invoice (net-30).

Immediate asks from our side to keep timeline tight:
- Novara to confirm preferred billing route (Marketplace vs Redwood invoice + PO).
- Legal to send any redlines by EOW week 2 so we can prepare private offer.
- Finance to confirm PO process and invoice code (GL account).

I included a SOC2 summary as requested.

Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0104

Attachment: MAP-v1.xlsx (Excel), SOC2_Summary.pdf (PDF)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Intro & request: evaluation plan + billing path for GCP private offer

Alex — adding a procurement checklist and some implementation notes so Novara’s finance/legal teams can see the gating items.

Quick procurement checklist (action owners in parens):
- Evaluation signoff criteria: 95th p95 latency < 250ms on 4k token batches; token cost within target (Novara target attached) (Novara / ML lead)
- Legal: review of Redwood DPA + SOC2; redlines back to us by 8/10 to hit timeline (Novara legal)
- Finance: confirm whether PO will be issued (preferred) or if you want us to route charges through GCP billing (Novara finance)
- Marketplace private offer: init request once PO or signed MSA addendum received; GCP private offer provisioning typically takes 3-5 business days (Redwood ops)
- Invoice trigger:
   - If Marketplace billing: charges flow through Google, Novara will see charges on GCP invoice; no separate Redwood invoice.
   - If Redwood invoice: we issue monthly invoices upon private offer activation; payment terms net-30.

If helpful, we can provision a temporary invoice route while Marketplace is being established — that avoids blocking pilots.

I also added a short list of what our billing team will need: billing contact name, GL codes, PO number, and who to copy on invoices.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

If we follow the timeline you proposed, we’re aiming for private offer activation around 8/20 and Marketplace billing live by 9/01. Please confirm if you need anything else from Novara to start onboarding.

Best,
Alex
